items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-08-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What did you use the A's for, Miley?

ctx.x: Yeah, for the Bs I had, I run into about three A's. For the Bs, I don't know, I run into about six or seven Bs. Yeah. Yeah. I rode all my carers.
What did you use the A's for, Miley? Any particular tunes, or what did you-
Well, during the time the music wasn't different. The music would come in them keys, you're saying-
